text:
Ravi: quick question for the group: we've seen a few tenants where active/active lease swaps cause brief compliance boundary crossings when a proxy reroutes on failover. Thinking about a 'consent-tagged lease snapshot' to avoid accidental writes in non-consent regions.

Noelle: explain the snapshot idea?

Ravi: idea is when a region becomes primary for a tenant we publish a short-lived snapshot token that includes consent-scoped flags (pii_allowed, escrowed_kms, residency_epoch). Any write from another region must present a matching snapshot token or be rejected. That avoids implicit state being created in the wrong jurisdiction during retries.

Hannah: sounds promising. how do tokens get distributed to proxies and how long do they live?

Ravi: token distribution via control-plane push to edge proxies; TTL default = 30s but configurable per-tenant. If proxy can't get a token it falls back to returning 409 with a hint to route to resident region.

Omar: operationally, we need to watch token issuance rate and token-sync lag. otherwise a brief control-plane partition could block writes everywhere.

Noelle: agree. we should have two modes: optimistic (allow local-accept+audit if token missing) and strict (reject). Strict only for high-risk tenants.

Hannah: how about lease handoff? when we flip resident region we issue a revocation and a new token; dataplane accepts writes only if token matches current epoch. That gives clear authoritative ordering.

Ravi: exact metadata shape: tenant.residency = "region:eu-west-1;epoch:128;consent:pii_restricted|escrowed|open". Token = base64(signed(region,epoch,consent,expiry)). Proxy header: X-Residency-Token.

Omar: metrics: token-miss-rate, token-accepts-by-mode, write-rejects-by-consent, controlplane-push-latency. Set alert when token-miss-rate > 0.5% p95 for any region.

Noelle: compliance: require audit log for any optimistic-local-accepts and automatic escalation to strict if audit export fails.

Hannah: test plan: simulate control-plane partition and ensure strict-mode tenants are blocked, optimistic tenants degrade to retry-with-hint, and token rotation works under burst failover.

infra-bot: created ticket ARCH-5783: consent-tagged-lease-snapshots + telemetry + canary plan.

Ravi: next steps: I'll draft a short RFC with token format, control-plane API, and proxy failure modes. Noelle/Hannah will annotate compliance/test concerns.

Noelle: +1, will review RFC and add legal matrix.

Hannah: +1, will own tests in staging.

Ravi: thanks y'all, dropping RFC link when ready. :pray:
